name: April Showers
source:
It's been a rough spring for Peter. There has been a significant lack of heart in the heartland, but with some help from his friends he'll land on his feet.

As they say, April showers bring May flowers.

[from [url=https://the-bjakery.itch.io/april-showers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对彼得来说，这是一个艰难的春天。中心地带的人严重缺乏热情，但在朋友的帮助下，他会站起来。

正如人们所说，四月的阵雨带来五月的鲜花。

[来自[url=https://the-bjakery.itch.io/april-showers]itch.io[/url]]
